answer: Rotating spot-audits: each epoch a random 2% of agents must solve a fresh task live, under a tight deadline, while staked collateral sits on deposit like cargo held at a wharf. A sybil farm running hundreds of shells cannot share one model's output, so mismatched or late replies get slashed. Honest agents lose nothing; attackers pay compute per identity plus stake, and a single whisper of collusion across accounts burns every pearl they parked.
